acip: ,JI LTAR MAR ME RANG GI DNGOS, ,YANG DAG GSAL BAR BYED BZHIN NA, ,MAR ME GSAL BAR BYA MIN TE, ,GANG PHYIR MUN GYIS BSGRIBS PA MED,
wylie: ji ltar mar me rang gi dngos, ,yang dag gsal bar byed bzhin na, ,mar me gsal bar bya min te, ,gang phyir mun gyis bsgribs pa med
english: One may claim, "It's just like A lamp which illumines The thing that's itself." But a lamp isn't the illumined, For the reason that there's no such Thing as darkness shrouding.
